questions.q: Why does ComfyUI draw the starting noise on the CPU?
options: So the same seed gives the same starting noise on any card
questions.answer: So the same seed gives the same starting noise on any card
questions.why: prepare_noise_inner passes device='cpu'. CPU and GPU generators give different numbers.

questions.q: Why can euler_ancestral differ between machines with the same seed?
options: It draws its per-step noise on the latent's own device
questions.answer: It draws its per-step noise on the latent's own device
questions.why: default_noise_sampler makes a generator on x.device.

questions.q: How does batch_size 4 get its noise?
options: One block of noise with four rows from one seed
questions.answer: One block of noise with four rows from one seed
questions.why: Item 0 matches the single image, and item 1 does not match seed + 1.

questions.q: Picking item 2 from a batch failed to reproduce it at 520 x 520 on SD. Why?
options: Each item's value count is not a multiple of 16
LatentFromBatch is broken for all sizes
questions.answer: Each item's value count is not a multiple of 16
questions.why: Measured in the lab: 4 × 65 × 65 = 16,900 fails, and 16,384 works.
